::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this chapter does

Use this chapter after analytical and disclosure review is complete. Approval and analytical publication are separate Stata actions:

- **approval** records the decision against the exact reviewed files; and
- **publication** verifies that approval and copies only those files to the official public analytical folder and the website folders.

Some generated folder names and menu labels use `candidate` for files proposed for approval and `public_ready` for the private approved copy that is ready for publication. These names do not mean that publication or website deployment has already happened.

::: {.callout-tip title="Procedure at a glance" appearance="simple"}
1. Confirm that review is complete for the exact private files proposed for approval.
2. An authorised BNR Lead or BNR Analyst runs the Stata approval action.
3. Check `approval.yml`, the approval record, and `public_manifest.csv`, the generated list of approved files.
4. Run the separate Stata publication action for the same product and version.
5. Check the official public analytical copy and the website copies.
6. Render, review and deploy the website separately.
:::

## Before you start

Confirm that:

- the proposed files have completed analytical review, automated checks and disclosure review;
- the product, reporting period, version and source data releases are correct;
- the proposed files and review evidence are complete and unchanged; and
- the named approver is authorised by BNR and uses either the **BNR Lead** or **BNR Analyst** role accepted by the production approval actions.

Do not approve on the basis of a successful build alone.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Input files"}

### CVD event data release

**Review folder:** `$BNR_STAGING/metrics/cvd/cvd_YYYY_MM/review/`

**Approved files folder:** `$BNR_STAGING/metrics/cvd/cvd_YYYY_MM/public_ready/`

| Input | Required check |
|---|---|
| `step5_review.xlsx` | Confirm that this is the completed workbook for the intended data release. |
| `step5_candidate.dta` | Confirm that this is the exact proposed dataset reviewed in the workbook. |
| `step5_disclosure_qa.csv` | Confirm that every automated disclosure check reports `PASS`. |
| `step5_equation_audit.csv` | Confirm that every automated related-value check reports `PASS`. |
| `step5_row_audit.dta` | Confirm that any row investigated during review has the expected disclosure result. |
| `step5_review_basis.csv` | Confirm the data-release identifier and the recorded file sizes and SHA-256 change-detection values. |
| `approval.yml` | Created by the approval action. Before publication, confirm that it records approval of the intended data-release package and named approver. |
| `public_manifest.csv` | Created by the approval action. Before publication, confirm that it lists the exact approved files. |
| Files listed in `public_manifest.csv` | Confirm that every listed file remains present and unchanged. |

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Code files"}

| File | How it is used |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step5_review_expanded_cvd_approve.do` | Approves the reviewed CVD event data-release package. |
| `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step6_publish_expanded_cvd.do` | Publishes the approved CVD event files. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s5_approve.do` | Approves the reviewed CVD mortality data-release package. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s6_publish.do` | Publishes the approved CVD mortality files. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s2_approve.do` | Approves the reviewed annual CVD report. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s3_publish.do` | Publishes the approved annual CVD report and companion Public Health Update. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s2_approve.do` | Approves the reviewed one-off CVD report. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s3_publish.do` | Publishes the approved one-off CVD report. |

The two report approval DO-files call `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_approve_candidate.do`. The two report publication DO-files call `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_publish_candidate.do`. These shared helper files enforce the common report checks; run the product-specific DO-files from the BNR menu, not the shared helpers directly.
:::

## Choose the product-specific actions

Open Stata and use **User > BNR**.

| Product | Approval action | Analytical publication action |
|---|---|---|
| CVD event data release | **Update CVD events dashboard > Step 5: Review and approve package for release** | **Step 6: Publish approved outputs** |
| CVD mortality data release | **Update CVD mortality dashboard > Step 5: Approve reviewed mortality release** | **Step 6: Publish approved mortality outputs** |
| Annual CVD report | **Annual CVD report > Step 2: Approve annual report candidate** | **Step 3: Publish approved annual report** |
| One-off CVD report | **One-off CVD report publication > Step 2: Approve one-off report candidate** | **Step 3: Publish approved one-off report** |

The rolling three-month update has one controlled build action. It uses exact approved event and mortality data-release files and does not create another analytical approval.

## Run the approval action

1. Open the approval action for the correct product.
2. Select the same product, reporting period and version that were reviewed.
3. Enter the authorised approver's full name and choose **BNR Lead** or **BNR Analyst**.
4. Complete every required confirmation only when it is true.
5. Run the approval action.
6. Confirm that the Stata operational summary reports the workflow-specific successful approval status.
7. Open the resulting `approval.yml` and `public_manifest.csv`. Confirm that they identify the intended package, approver, role and files. Do not create or edit either file manually.

Approval does not copy the package to the public folders or deploy the website.

## Publish the approved package

1. Open the separate publication action for the same product.
2. Select the approved product, reporting period and version.
3. Run the publication action.
4. Confirm that the Stata operational summary reports the workflow-specific successful publication status.
5. Check that the official public analytical folder contains the expected files.
6. Check the website copy and any release-stamped or stable copy created by that workflow.

The publication DO-file verifies `approval.yml`, `public_manifest.csv` and each approved file's recorded SHA-256 change-detection value before copying anything. It must stop if the product details, role, recorded file values, file count or required confirmation differ from the approved package.

## Complete website publication separately

Analytical publication does not make the website change live.

After the Stata publication succeeds:

1. start the normal Info-Hub editing session;
2. render and inspect the site locally;
3. review the Git changes on a development branch;
4. merge the reviewed branch into `main` through a GitHub pull request;
5. confirm that the GitHub Actions build and deployment succeed; and
6. check the affected live pages and downloads.

Follow [Render and publish the website](../website/render-publish.qmd) for the exact VS Code, Git and deployment procedure.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="If approval or publication does not complete"}
These actions should complete routinely when the reviewed files and their automatically generated control files remain unchanged.

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| The product, version or source data release is not the reviewed one | Stop and select the exact reviewed files. Do not approve or publish a different package. |
| `public_manifest.csv`, a recorded size or SHA-256 value, or a proposed file has changed | Stop. Rebuild the proposed files from the earliest affected step and repeat review and approval. Do not repair the control files manually. |
| Public output already exists unexpectedly | Stop and confirm why it exists. Use a workflow's replacement route only for an explicitly authorised correction, recovery or higher version. |

For other problems, see [Fix common problems](../maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd).
:::
